title: Smoked Italian Black Bean Tacos
description: A delicious and flavorful taco recipe featuring smoked Italian sausage, juicy black beans, and a hint of roman spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the smoked Italian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the roman spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the black beans to the skillet and stir to combine with the sausage and spice blend.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the sausage and bean mixture into the shells.
Top with shredded cheese, sour cream, and salsa.
